findings.title: Inverted lightness in embedded-post author color breaks both themes
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss line 291 the rule for .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The light-theme branch no longer preserves the original 30% and will render much lighter than before, while the dark-theme branch uses 30% instead of the expected 100-30=70% and will be too dark on a dark background with poor contrast. It should be 30% / 70%.

findings.title: Mobile custom-message-length lightness flipped vs desktop and original
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss line 102 .custom-message-length changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The light-theme value changes from 70% to 30%, darkening mobile modals versus before and versus desktop/modal.scss line 94 which correctly uses 70% / 30%. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)) to preserve light theme and match desktop.

findings.title: Mobile topic-map h3 lightness changed instead of preserved
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss line 182 .topic-map h3 changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). This alters the existing light-theme color from 20% to 50% and uses 50% for dark theme instead of the expected 100-20=80%, diverging from desktop/topic-post.scss which correctly uses 20% / 80%. Result is lighter headings on light theme and too-dark low-contrast headings on dark theme. It should be 20% / 80%.

findings.title: Group member name color lightened and dark variant wrong
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss line 522 .group-member-info .name changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme branch changes from 30% to 50%, lightening existing UI, and the dark-theme branch uses 50% instead of expected 70%. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)) as done in common/base/user.scss.

findings.title: Mobile group member name color lightened and dark variant wrong
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss line 497 .group-member-info .name changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). This breaks preservation of the original 30% light-theme color and provides 50% for dark theme instead of the expected 70%, causing lighter text on light theme and too-dark text on dark theme. It should be 30% / 70%.
